description: This file defines the 'NotesFlow' class which manages note-related use cases such as creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, searching notes, and managing tags and favorites in a notes backend system. It includes functions for converting database rows to note dictionaries, ensuring tags exist, replacing note tags, and building SQL filters.

classes.name: NotesFlow
classes.description: Orchestration layer for all note-related use cases, including CRUD operations, search, tag management, and favorites.

methods.name: _row_to_note
methods.description: Converts a database row into a note dictionary, including fetching associated tags.

methods.name: _ensure_tags
methods.description: Ensures tags exist in the database, creating them if necessary, and returns their IDs.

methods.name: _replace_note_tags
methods.description: Replaces the tags associated with a specific note.

methods.name: _build_filters
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE clause and parameters based on tag and favorites filters.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title, content, and tags.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: delete_note
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: update_note
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing note, including tags and favorite status.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Lists notes with optional tag and favorite filters, with pagination.

methods.name: search_notes
methods.description: Searches notes by text query with optional filters, with pagination.

methods.name: list_tags
methods.description: Returns list of tags with counts of associated notes.

methods.name: set_favorite
methods.description: Sets the favorite status of a note.
